features: Cinematic Dolby Audio: Upgrade your watch parties with the boAt Aavante Bar A3070 Dolby Bluetooth Soundbar. Cinematic Dolby Audio surrounds you from all directions for a transformative viewing experience like never before!

300 W boAt Signature Sound: Kickstart fun gaming sessions and movie nights with the booming 300 W boAt Signature Sound of this soundbar. Stay engrossed in edge-of-the-seat thrillers and fast-paced games with powerful audio.
2.1-Channel Soundbar: Get transported to the digital realm with the 2.1 channels of this soundbar. Also, the wired subwoofer enhances the sound so that you stay engrossed in the content.
Dynamic LEDs: Boost your entertainment with this soundbar’s LEDs. Let your favorite tunes play while you groove to eye-catching lights.

Multichannel Connectivity: Stream and game with a host of connectivity options. Connect your media device with Aavante Bar A3070 Dolby effortlessly using wireless Bluetooth v5.4 or AUX, optical, HDMI (ARC), and USB ports.
EQ Modes: With four EQ modes that cater to every type of content, this soundbar heightens your audio experience. Choose from Music, Movies, News, and 3D modes, and unwind to your favorite content.
Attractive Sleek Design: Make your home stand out with this soundbar and create a dedicated entertainment hub for enjoying movies, music, podcasts, and more.
Bass and Treble Controls: Attune the bass and treble to your preference with the two-band equalizer of this soundbar. Dial up the party vibe in no time with a single tap!
Master Remote: Tweak the audio to your liking with the handy master remote control. Modify the volume, change the input source, switch EQ modes, and do more without getting up from your viewing spot.
Wall-Mountable Design: Amp your audio zone with Aavante Bar A3070 Dolby. Place the soundbar on your TV cabinet or mount it on the wall for an optimal arrangement.
